study_identification_part.si_4_title: A neuroimaging measure to capture heterogeneous patterns of atrophy in Parkinson ' s disease and dementia with Lewy bodies

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative lifespan curves were modelled using warped Bayesian Linear Regression.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Rutherford and colleagues (Rutherford et al., 2022) modelled normative lifespan curves ... using Bayesian Linear Regression ... Bayesian linear regression with likelihood warping allows accurate modelling of non-Gaussian effects ... All modelling steps were performed using PCNToolkit (v0.20)
